units.source_text: 紫姬心中的怨恨，每逢机会，自然会不由得泄露出来。

en.t: The resentment in Lady Murasaki's heart would naturally slip out whenever an opportunity arose.

units.source_text: 然而她竭力抑制，外表若无其事。

en.t: Yet she did her utmost to suppress it and appeared outwardly as if nothing were wrong.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得此心甚可感佩。

en.t: Genji felt that this restraint of hers was deeply admirable.

units.source_text: 今宵各方面都闲暇无事，他就不顾一切，偷偷地出去访问胧月夜了。

en.t: That night, with everyone on all sides free and unoccupied, he cast caution aside and secretly went out to visit Oborozukiyo.

units.source_text: 明知此事大不应该，努力打消此念，然而终于无可奈何。

en.t: Although he knew perfectly well that this was very improper and tried hard to drive the thought away, in the end he could do nothing against it.
